apps.name: Beaver
apps.subtitle: AI-powered voice notes
apps.localizedDescription: A note-taking app with AI-powered transcription, summarization, and iCloud sync.

versions.localizedDescription: - Add Keep Screen Awake setting — prevents device auto-lock while the app is open

- Tap a note to open its detail view (Summary/Transcript tabs)
- Tap any transcript word or summary point to seek playback there
- Word/point highlighting synced to playback
- Fixed a navigation bug where tapping a note sometimes did nothing
- Fixed Keychain writes silently failing on ad-hoc/self-signed builds
